articles.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
articles.snippet: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

articles.title: Former Swift CEO joins stablecoin firm OpenTrade as chairman
articles.snippet: Lazaro Campos takes the board role as the London-based company reports $300 million in assets locked and more than $1 billion in annual transaction volume.

articles.title: Binance investigates potential multibillion-dollar hack
articles.snippet: Binance said it is investigating a potential security breach after suspicious wallet transfers, while co-founder CZ reported nearly $1.8 billion in frozen stablecoins.

articles.title: Private, fast USDT is coming to Bitcoin. Can it compete with Ethereum and Tron?
articles.snippet: USDT is coming home to Bitcoin, offering privacy and Lightning-fast payments. But can Bitcoin’s revamped version of Tether compete with stablecoins on ETH and TRON?

articles.title: Polygon Extends Its Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure to Solana
articles.snippet: The expansion gives Solana businesses one integration to connect bank funding, embedded wallets, cross-chain transfers and global payouts, with cross-border firm Kira among the first adopters.
